title: How a body survived a 33,333-foot fall ✈️
subject: airplane
description:
Would you get back on a plane after this? 👇

On January 26, 1972, flight attendant Vesna Vulović fell 33,333 feet (10,160 m) inside the tail of JAT Flight 367 and survived. It's still the Guinness World Record for the highest fall survived without a parachute.

Sources: Guinness World Records, "How Vesna Vulović survived the highest fall ever with no parachute" (2022) and "Highest fall survived without parachute".

scenes.text: You can survive falling 6 miles. One woman did.
January 26, 1972. An explosion tore apart JAT Flight 367 at 33,333 feet.
Flight attendant Vesna Vulović, 23, was pinned in the tail by a food cart.
Her piece of the fuselage hit thick snow at a lucky angle, in woods in Czechoslovakia.
Her skull, pelvis, both legs and 3 vertebrae broke. She was paralyzed below the waist.
Ten months later she walked again. She never remembered the fall.
